changes.previous: Python application and CLI were the production entry.
changes.current: TypeScript Application, CLI and portable package are the production runtime; Python files are historical maintenance material.
changes.reason: Explicit full Python-to-TypeScript migration target and T061 retirement.

changes.previous: Original migration draft proposed a broader generic action union.
changes.current: Agent capability remains six closed actions; operator text/pointer input is a separate authenticated command.
changes.reason: Preserves accepted ADR 0023 least privilege while completing the migration.

changes.previous: Navigation-wide prefetch was used as a PDF capture shortcut.
changes.current: Native navigation continues by default; response/download/blob/data/frame/popup capture is admitted and spooled separately.
changes.reason: Separates Browser, Network and Acquisition ownership and avoids treating HTML as a PDF.

changes.previous: Long-running completion was process-local and request-bound.
changes.current: Jobs, targets, attempts, policy snapshots, events, leases, candidates and interventions are durable in the explicit v2 schema.
changes.reason: Required for restart, pause and candidate reconciliation without a second literature state.

changes.previous: Python Quick/Full were the default project gate.
changes.current: TypeScript Quick/Full are the default gate; Python Harness remains an explicit historical maintenance command.
changes.reason: Owner decision dated 2026-09-10; preserves historical checks without slowing TS delivery.

non_changes: MetaLiterature/Literature identity, provenance, current facts, v1 schema and immutable asset rules remain unchanged.
No production Catalog, Profile, credential or external Provider was accessed during migration validation.
